class.name: FmodSound
class.brief_description: A playable instance of a raw audio file loaded outside of FMOD Studio banks.
class.description:
FmodSound plays back audio files loaded with [method FmodServer.load_file_as_sound] or [method FmodServer.load_file_as_music]. This is the low-level path for playing audio outside of FMOD Studio's event system.
[codeblock] FmodServer.load_file_as_sound("res://audio/ambience.ogg") var sound = FmodServer.create_sound_instance("res://audio/ambience.ogg") sound.play() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_pitch
method.description: Returns the pitch multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal pitch.

method.name: get_volume
method.description: Returns the volume multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal volume.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the sound is currently playing.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying FMOD channel handle is still valid.

method.name: release
method.description: Releases the sound instance and frees its resources.

method.name: set_pitch
method.description: Sets the pitch multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal pitch.

method.name: set_volume
method.description: Sets the volume multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal volume.
